svg.text: From a user's posts to a high-risk score
Hidden states from four language models are pooled, compressed to 1024 features, and passed to two classifiers.
fit on each training fold only
The weights choose among the 4 positions inside each model and layer. This is not attention over tokens.
Depth, width, learning rate, and epochs are chosen on each fold's development set.
Big Five: O, C, E, A, N
high risk means a score of 3 or more
Logit + 0.1 × predicted PHQ-9: mean test AUC 0.734
The PHQ-9 term is a ridge prediction from the 1024 features, fit on the training fold.
